LESSON: ZACCHAEUS THE TAX COLLECTOR

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible Bible Stories:
Topic 2.2: Zacchaeus the Tax Collector

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Zacchaeus the Tax Collector
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How did Zacchaeus’ encounter with Jesus Christ change his behaviour?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. retell the story of Zacchaeus
2. demonstrate integrity when using money
3. discuss why it is important to repent sins in order to be like Christ

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: retell the story of Zacchaeus

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: discuss why it is important to repent sins in order to be like Christ

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: retell the story of Zacchaeus
• Model 2: demonstrate integrity when using money
• Model 3: discuss why it is important to repent sins in order to be like Christ

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: retell the story of Zacchaeus
2. Practise: demonstrate integrity when using money
3. Practise: discuss why it is important to repent sins in order to be like Christ

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Zacchaeus’ encounter with Jesus Christ change his behaviour?

• discuss why it is important to repent sins in order to be like Christ
